title: Opinions, agreeing, disagreeing
intro: Meetings in English need more than good grammar. Learn to give your view clearly, agree and disagree without offending anyone, and stay in control when you interrupt or need something explained.
introBn: মিটিংয়ে মতামত দেওয়া, একমত বা দ্বিমত করা, কথার মাঝে ঢোকা আর প্রশ্ন করে বুঝে নেওয়ার ভদ্র ইংরেজি শিখুন।

units.title: Giving opinions and agreeing
units.idea: Introduce opinions with a soft opener such as I think, In my view or As I see it. Agree clearly, or agree partly before adding your own point.
units.ideaBn: মতামত দেওয়ার আগে I think, In my view বা As I see it ব্যবহার করুন। পুরোপুরি বা আংশিকভাবে একমত হওয়ার ভাষাও শিখুন।

formula.name: Opinion
formula.pos: I think… · In my view,… · As I see it,… · Personally, I feel…

formula.name: Agree
formula.pos: I agree (with you). · Absolutely. · That's a good point.

formula.name: Partly agree
formula.pos: I agree up to a point, but… · That's true, but…

uses.rule: Use 'I think' + clause; for negatives say 'I don't think…'.
uses.bn: নেতিবাচক মতামতে I don't think… বলুন, I think… not নয়।
uses.ex: I don't think the deadline is realistic.

uses.rule: 'In my view' and 'As I see it' sound more formal and thoughtful.
uses.bn: মিটিংয়ে In my view বেশি ভারী ও চিন্তাশীল শোনায়।
uses.ex: In my view, we should hire two more developers.

uses.rule: Agree is a verb: I agree, not I am agree.
uses.bn: agree ক্রিয়া, তাই I am agree ভুল।
uses.ex: I agree with Rafi on this.

uses.rule: Agree partly, then add your point with 'but'.
uses.bn: আগে আংশিক একমত, তারপর but দিয়ে নিজের কথা।
uses.ex: I agree up to a point, but the budget is still too tight.

uses.rule: 'According to me' is not natural; use 'In my opinion'.
uses.ex: In my opinion, the client will accept the offer.

traps.bn: agree এর আগে am লাগে না।

traps.wrong: According to me, the plan is good.
traps.right: In my opinion, the plan is good.
traps.why: According to is for other people's views or sources.
traps.bn: নিজের মতের জন্য In my opinion।

traps.wrong: I think it is not a good idea.
traps.right: I don't think it's a good idea.
traps.bn: না-বাচক অংশ think এর সাথে বসান।

drills.q: A meeting about a new office.
drills.s: ___ , moving to Gulshan would cost too much.

drills.x: I agree, never I am agree.

o: I am think it won't work.
I don't think it will work.
I not think it will work.
drills.a: I don't think it will work.

drills.q: Your boss suggests Friday. You partly agree.
drills.s: I agree up to a ___ , but Friday is busy for the clients.
drills.x: Fixed phrase: up to a point.

drills.q: Pick the most natural reply to 'We should start earlier.'
o: Absolutely. That would give us more time.
drills.a: Absolutely. That would give us more time.

drills.s: As I ___ it, the problem is communication.
drills.x: As I see it = in my opinion.

drills.q: ব্যক্তিগতভাবে, আমার মনে হয় আমাদের অপেক্ষা করা উচিত।
o: Personally, I think we should wait.
Personally, I am thinking we should to wait.
According to me, we should wait.
Personally, my think is we wait.
drills.a: Personally, I think we should wait.

units.title: Disagreeing, interrupting, clarifying
units.idea: Disagree politely by softening: I'm not sure I agree, I see what you mean, but… In meetings, interrupt with permission and check meaning with clear questions.
units.ideaBn: ভদ্রভাবে দ্বিমত করুন। মিটিংয়ে অনুমতি নিয়ে কথার মাঝে ঢুকুন আর বুঝতে না পারলে স্পষ্ট প্রশ্ন করুন।

formula.name: Disagree
formula.pos: I'm not sure I agree. · I see what you mean, but… · I'm afraid I disagree.

formula.name: Interrupt
formula.pos: Sorry to interrupt, but… · Can I just come in here?

formula.name: Clarify
formula.pos: Sorry, what do you mean by…? · Could you go over that again? · So are you saying…?

uses.rule: Soften disagreement with I'm not sure or I'm afraid.
uses.bn: I'm not sure / I'm afraid দিয়ে দ্বিমত নরম করুন।
uses.ex: I'm not sure I agree. The client wants it sooner.

uses.bn: দ্বিমতের আগে বোঝান যে আপনি শুনেছেন।
uses.ex: I see what you mean, but the cost is too high.

uses.bn: কথার মাঝে ঢুকতে আগে sorry বলুন।
uses.ex: Sorry to interrupt, but we only have ten minutes left.

uses.rule: Ask about a specific word or idea.
uses.bn: নির্দিষ্ট শব্দ বা বিষয় নিয়ে প্রশ্ন করুন।
uses.ex: Sorry, what do you mean by 'phase two'?

uses.rule: Check understanding with 'So are you saying…?'
uses.bn: বুঝেছেন কিনা যাচাই করতে So are you saying…?
uses.ex: So are you saying we need to delay the launch?

traps.right: Could you say that again, please?
traps.why: 'Repeat again' doubles the idea and sounds like an order.
traps.bn: repeat again দ্বিরুক্তি এবং আদেশের মতো শোনায়।

drills.q: Pick the most polite way to disagree with a senior colleague.
o: I see what you mean, but I'm not sure the client will agree.
drills.a: I see what you mean, but I'm not sure the client will agree.

drills.q: You need to speak while the manager is talking.
drills.s: Sorry to ___ , but the client is on the phone.

drills.q: You did not understand a word.
drills.s: Sorry, what do you ___ by 'soft launch'?

drills.q: আপনি কি বলছেন আমাদের বাজেট কমাতে হবে?
o: So are you saying we need to cut the budget?
So you are say we cut budget?
So are you telling that we need cut the budget?
So you saying we need to cut the budget?
drills.a: So are you saying we need to cut the budget?

drills.s: I'm ___ I disagree. The numbers don't support that.

drills.q: Pick the best request for clarification.
o: Could you go over the last point again, please?
drills.a: Could you go over the last point again, please?

drills.s: Can I just ___ in here? I have some data on this.

drills.q: Strong but polite disagreement in a formal meeting.
drills.s: I'm not sure I ___ go along with that, to be honest.
drills.x: I'm not sure I would… softens a strong no.

drills.q: আমি বুঝতে পারছি আপনি কী বলতে চাইছেন, কিন্তু সময় খুব কম।
o: I see what you mean, but there isn't much time.
I understand what you want to say, but time is very less.
I see what you are meaning, but time is few.
I see your mean, but there isn't much time.
drills.a: I see what you mean, but there isn't much time.

o: I am agree with the plan.
I agreed with the plan now.

mastery.s: ___ , the new system will save time.
I ___ think we can finish by Thursday.

mastery.q: দুঃখিত, বাধা দিচ্ছি, কিন্তু আমাদের সময় শেষ।
o: Sorry to interrupt, but we're out of time.
Sorry for disturb, but our time is finish.
Sorry to interrupting, but time is over.
Sorry, I interrupt, but we have no more time is.
mastery.a: Sorry to interrupt, but we're out of time.

mastery.q: Pick the most natural partial agreement.
o: That's true, but we also need to think about the cost.
mastery.a: That's true, but we also need to think about the cost.

mastery.s: So are you ___ that the client cancelled?
